_comment_coupling: Temperature and skin conductance are DC-coupled by nature — there is no AC path to speak of.
_comment_channels: BrainFlow's EmotiBit ancillary preset. TH is the MLX90632 medical thermopile aimed at skin; T1 is the MAX30101 die sensor on the board. Both are degrees C despite kind 'other' — Refrain has no temperature dimension (see the protocol's units note).
